In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''dodecahedral-icosahedral honeycomb''' is a uniform [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]], constructed from [[dodecahedron]], [[icosahedron]], and [[icosidodecahedron]] cells, in a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] [[vertex figure]].

{{Honeycomb}}

== Images==
Wide-angle perspective views:
<gallery mode="packed" heights="240">
File:H3 5353-0010 center ultrawide.png|Centered on dodecahedron
File:H3 5353-1000 center ultrawide.png|Centered on icosahedron
</gallery>

== Related honeycombs==

There are 5 related uniform honeycombs generated within the same family, generated with 2 or more rings of the Coxeter group {{CDD|label5|branch|3ab|branch|label5}}: {{CDD|label5|branch_10r|3ab|branch_10l|label5}}, {{CDD|label5|branch_01r|3ab|branch_10l|label5}}, {{CDD|label5|branch_11|3ab|branch|label5}}, {{CDD|label5|branch_11|3ab|branch_10l|label5}}, {{CDD|label5|branch_11|3ab|branch_11|label5}}.

The '''rectified dodecahedral-icosahedral honeycomb''' is a compact uniform [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]], constructed from [[icosidodecahedron]] and [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] cells, in a [[cuboid]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a Coxeter diagram {{CDD|label5|branch_01r|3ab|branch_10l|label5}}.

[[File:H3_5353-1010_center_ultrawide.png|480px]]
:Perspective view from center of rhombicosidodecahedron
{{Clear}}

The '''cyclotruncated dodecahedral-icosahedral honeycomb''' is a compact uniform [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]], constructed from [[truncated dodecahedron]] and [[icosahedron]] cells, in a [[pentagonal antiprism]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a Coxeter diagram {{CDD|label5|branch_11|3ab|branch|label5}}.

[[File:H3_5353-1100_center_ultrawide.png|480px]]
:Perspective view from center of icosahedron

The '''cyclotruncated icosahedral-dodecahedral honeycomb''' is a compact uniform [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]], constructed from [[dodecahedron]] and [[truncated icosahedron]] cells, in a [[triangular antiprism]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a Coxeter diagram {{CDD|label5|branch_10r|3ab|branch_10l|label5}}.

[[File:H3_5353-0110_center_ultrawide.png|480px]]
:Perspective view from center of dodecahedron

It can be seen as somewhat analogous to the [[pentahexagonal tiling]], which has pentagonal and hexagonal faces:
: [[File:H2 tiling 355-5.png|160px]]
{{Clear}}

The '''truncated dodecahedral-icosahedral honeycomb''' is a compact uniform [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]], constructed from [[truncated icosahedron]], [[truncated dodecahedron]], [[rhombicosidodecahedron]], and [[truncated icosidodecahedron]] cells, in a [[square pyramid|trapezoidal pyramid]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a Coxeter diagram {{CDD|label5|branch_11|3ab|branch_10l|label5}}.

[[File:H3_5353-1101_center_ultrawide.png|480px]]
:Perspective view from center of truncated icosahedron
{{Clear}}
